applicability: Checking aggregate external support on the exact free-pad fixture before constructing an articulated contact-bearing limb
Preventing local predicted contact impulses from being promoted into an unmeasured general foot load
claim: In the exact certified L3.0 free unary pad fixture, whole-system momentum balance reconstructs 19.6, 39.6, 59.6, and 99.6 newtons of total external normal support under the centered 0, 20, 40, and 80 newton imposed-load cells, while the single-manifold raw predicted contact load remains only a bounded cross-check.

evidence.certification_claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the exact L3.0-L3.2 free unary loaded-pad observations named by the source-pinned programs. The force-controlled carriage is an explicit apply_force boundary and not a rail; centered normal loading, loaded shear breakaway, predicted contact-pressure edge migration, and rocking retain their declared fixture, load, geometry, material, timestep, and solver scopes. It establishes no general contact wrench, per-contact or per-foot load allocation, articulated load-bearing limb, standing, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, walking, accepted knowledge, or automatic creature guidance.

program.claim_scope: The declared free unary pad reconstructs total external normal support under the exact centered 0, 20, 40, and 80 N load cells, while raw predicted contact load remains a bounded single-manifold cross-check.

failure_boundaries: The externally imposed force-controlled carriage is not a joint, limb, muscle, or creature body
The aggregate reconstruction establishes no per-contact, per-foot, or per-toe load allocation and no general contact wrench
No articulated load-bearing limb, standing, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, or walking is established
mechanism: System momentum change minus known gravity and imposed-force impulses isolates the unknown external floor impulse. Dividing its support-normal component by the measured timestep gives aggregate external support load without treating a local solver manifold as a general force sensor.
scope: Only the exact free 2 kg, 0.30 by 0.08 by 0.20 meter unary pad, centered force schedule, force-controlled apply_force carriage boundary, material, timestep, solver configuration, tolerances, and program claim scope certified by br3b_20260723T103240Z_f5f54a58.
title: Whole-system momentum reconstructs the certified centered load on the free unary pad
unknowns: How aggregate external support should be allocated among multiple simultaneous feet or contacts
Whether an articulated actuator can produce and retain the measured support without an imposed carriage force
